lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12-14 distinct white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is irregular, generally narrower in the center of the torso and wider towards the shoulder and haunch regions.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One distinct Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the fifth vertical line from the posterior, located approximately at the mid-horizontal axis of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple dashed line segments are present, notably the first two lines on the posterior haunch and several central lines that fail to connect to the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 6 high-contrast white spots is localized on the mid-to-lower haunch area, above the knee joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three primary spots in the center of the haunch cluster align to form a near-perfect horizontal geometric line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a lyrate curve, extending dorsoposteriorly from the skull at a 40-degree angle before spiraling laterally and upward.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 4.2 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Lighter ivory-colored tipping is visible on the final 10-15% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, elongated white-tipped dorsal mane extends from the neck to the tail base. There is a distinct white chevron marking across the nasal bridge and a white patch on the lower throat.
